ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated medially and 35% high-intensity (white) pixels localized distally.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous blobs located on the outer lobes. Left lobe: irregularly shaped white patch extending from the upper-leading edge to the mid-section with internal dark mottling. Right lobe: elongated white patch along the upper margin, tapering towards the fluke tip. The central axial region is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with an approximate 22-degree interior angle; vertical penetration depth is approximately 12% of the fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Serration amplitude increases from the median notch toward the distal tips, with distinct peak-to-valley intervals of 8-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curve fitted to both the left and right trailing edges, terminating in upwardly swept, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-intensity circular pixels (barnacle scars) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, and scattered along the lower-right margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear streaks (rake marks) cutting diagonally across the high-intensity white patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, immediately adjacent to the median notch, suggesting minor tissue loss.
